description: A paymentIntentClientSecret that does not look like a PaymentIntent secret. Pins today's behaviour; the difference is parity gap G1 in PARITY-GAPS.md, not fixed here.

ios.result.error.message: `secret` format does not match expected client secret formatting.

parityGaps.result.error.code: G1: iOS preparePaymentSheetInstance validates the client secret format at init (Errors.isPIClientSecretValid) and fails; Android PaymentSheetManager accepts it and resolves {}, so the error only surfaces at present time.
